title: Morocco parts ways with coach Regragui before World Cup, Ouahbi appointed
summary: Morocco parted ways with coach Walid Regragui on Thursday, three months before the World Cup, appointing Mohamed Ouahbi as his successor, the national federation said. Regragui departs despite leading Morocco to the 2022 World Cup semi-finals. Ouahbi, 49, previously guided the country to the Under-20 World Cup title in October.
